'''Cryptology''' was a department within the [[Intentions]] branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]<ref name="RASB" /> and later the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].<ref name="R" /> Cryptology had the responsibility for attempting to decipher [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] codes. Although equipped with the best [[Communications droid/Legends|communications droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]] the Alliance could procure, Cryptology only managed a success rate of fifteen percent of civil codes, and five percent of military ciphers. Their primary assignment was cracking the [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] encoded by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], which had proven resistant to every effort tried by Cryptology. Through the efforts of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], Cryptology [[Operation Cobolt|acquired]] a [[scandoc decoding computer]] through which they hoped to gain a better understanding of how the scandoc coding procedure worked.<ref name="RASB" />
